title: Quiz: Debugging Strategies
description: Check your understanding of Debugging Strategies.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Dart?
questions.explanation: In Dart, // marks a comment. Block comments use /* */.

questions.question: What should you do FIRST when you find a bug?
options: Reproduce it reliably and note the exact steps
questions.correctAnswer: Reproduce it reliably and note the exact steps
questions.explanation: You cannot fix what you cannot reproduce.

questions.question: True or False: Adding print statements to inspect values is a legitimate debugging technique.
Fill in the blank: console/log the value of ___ to see what it holds
questions.explanation: Inspecting variable values reveals logic errors.

questions.question: In Dart, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
